description: TypeScript interface definitions for booking report repository, including data models, filters, and method signatures for managing booking reports.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Creates a new booking report with the provided input data.

methods.name: findAllReportedBookings
methods.description: Retrieves all reported bookings with optional filtering, pagination, and search.

methods.name: findGroupedReportedBookings
methods.description: Retrieves grouped reported bookings with optional filtering, pagination, and search.

methods.name: findReportsByIds
methods.description: Fetches booking reports by their IDs.

methods.name: linkWatchlistToReport
methods.description: Links a watchlist to a specific report.

methods.name: updateReportStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific report.

methods.name: bulkLinkWatchlistWithStatus
methods.description: Links multiple reports to watchlists with a specified status.

methods.name: bulkLinkGlobalWatchlistWithSystemStatus
methods.description: Links multiple reports to global watchlists with a system status.

methods.name: countPendingReports
methods.description: Counts the number of pending reports for an organization.

methods.name: updateSystemReportStatus
methods.description: Updates the system status of a report.

methods.name: bulkUpdateSystemReportStatus
methods.description: Bulk updates system status for multiple reports.

methods.name: dismissReportsByEmail
methods.description: Dismisses reports associated with an email and status for an organization.

methods.name: dismissSystemReportsByEmail
methods.description: Dismisses system reports associated with an email.

methods.name: findPendingReportsByEmail
methods.description: Finds pending reports by email for an organization.

methods.name: findPendingReportsByDomain
methods.description: Finds pending reports by domain for an organization.

methods.name: findPendingSystemReportsByEmail
methods.description: Finds pending system reports by email.

methods.name: findPendingSystemReportsByDomain
methods.description: Finds pending system reports by domain.
